(a) In General.--Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of this Act, the Federal Judicial Center, using existing resources, shall develop recommended best practices for-- (1) the seizure of information and media storing the information;
(b) Updates.--The Federal Judicial Center shall update the recommended best practices developed under subsection (a) from time to time.
